summary.title: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

details: Outcome-only verifiable rewards in long-horizon multi-turn agentic RL yield a single trajectory-level advantage broadcast uniformly over turns, so pivotal decisions cannot be distinguished from routine ones.
Existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) signals are token-local and history-independent, so they do not express sequential credit.
AgentOPSD: a critic-free, rollout-free turn-level credit-assignment scheme that reshapes the GRPO advantage.

Token-level teacher-student log-probability gaps (same policy conditioned on a training-only privileged 'skill' vs. not) are summed within a turn into turn-level Bayesian evidence, interpreted as an approximate Bayes factor for eventual trajectory success.

Evidence is accumulated recursively in log-odds space with geometric decay, starting from a prior set to the group success rate; a turn's credit is the marginal belief revision, signed by the outcome advantage and applied as a bounded, sign-preserving multiplier on the sequence-level advantage.
ALFWorld (six household task categories, up to 50 turns), success rate.
WebShop (128 fixed validation tasks from GiGPO, up to 15 turns), Score and exact-completion accuracy.
Search-QA in the Search-R1 setup with E5 retrieval, up to 4 turns; NQ and HotpotQA in-domain, TriviaQA/PopQA/2Wiki/MuSiQue/Bamboogle held out; accuracy.
Privileged skills retrieved by keyword matching from SkillRL's SkillBank, used only during training; no skills at inference.
150 steps, group size G=8, lr 1e-6, clip 0.2/0.24, KL coefficient 0.01; one extra teacher forward pass per turn, no extra rollouts or critic.
Reshaping weight lambda=0.5, multiplier band b=0.2, evidence decay gamma=0.95, prior B0 = clipped group success rate; single shared configuration across all environments and scales.
Group-relative RL: GRPO, Skill-GRPO (with/without skills at eval).
Self-distillation RL using the same teacher-student gap: OPSD, GRPO+OPSD, Skill-SD, RLSD, SDAR, StepOPSD; all share backbone, data, and budget.
Component removals on ALFWorld/7B: per-token instead of turn-level accumulation, raw local gap e_k instead of belief revision, magnitude only (drop outcome sign), drop empirical group-rate prior B0.
Sensitivity sweeps over lambda, gamma, and epsilon_high on three model/environment configurations.
Horizon analysis: OLS slope of per-sub-task success against mean turns of successful episodes.

Theory appendix: conditions under which the self-teacher contrast approximates the Bayes factor (sign/ranking preserved), plus boundedness, sign preservation, GRPO recovery at lambda=0, and telescoping of belief increments.

key_findings.finding: Recursive belief-based turn credit outperforms GRPO and strong self-distillation baselines that use identical privileged information.
key_findings.evidence: On ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B it reaches 89.1% success vs. 81.2 for GRPO and 88.4 for StepOPSD; it beats GRPO+OPSD, Skill-SD, and RLSD on all eight aggregate comparisons across the two model scales and exceeds SDAR on six of eight; Search-QA average 49.2 (7B) and 46.7 (3B), WebShop score 90.2/90.4.

key_findings.finding: The gains concentrate in long-horizon regimes where uniform credit is most harmful.
key_findings.evidence: Regressing per-sub-task success on the measured mean number of turns of successful ALFWorld episodes (Qwen2.5-7B) gives a slope of -0.54 success points per extra turn for AgentOPSD versus -2.91 for GRPO and -3.59 for RLSD; hyperparameter spread also shrinks sharply on the 4-turn Search-QA task.

key_findings.finding: A local self-distillation gap is not sequential credit: recursion, outcome-aligned sign, and the group-rate prior each matter.
key_findings.evidence: ALFWorld/7B ablations drop from 89.1 to 82.8 when replacing the belief revision with the raw local gap, to 80.5 when keeping only the magnitude, and to 78.9 when removing the empirical group-success-rate prior B0.

key_findings.finding: Aggregating gaps at environment-aligned turn boundaries beats token-level accumulation.
key_findings.evidence: Running the same recursion over the flattened token sequence lowers ALFWorld/7B success from 89.1 to 85.9.

key_findings.finding: The method is robust to its continuous knobs except the reshaping strength, which should be set high.
key_findings.evidence: Sweeps show lambda=0.5 is best with monotone degradation for smaller values (89.1 vs 84.4/85.9/83.6 on ALFWorld; 46.7 vs 45.1/40.2/45.4 on Search), while gamma in {1.0,0.9,0.8} and epsilon_high in {0.2,0.28} vary results by only a few points with no clear trend.
